C1112.title: Deepfake Sex Crimes Surge: South Korea Reports 297 Cases in First Seven Months
C1112.summary: In September 2024, it was reported that deepfake sex crimes in South Korea are on the rise, with 297 cases recorded in the first seven months of the year alone. The victims are predominantly young women, including students, teachers, and soldiers, with nearly two-thirds being teenagers. Most cases involve perpetrators known to the victims.

references.title: Deepfake Sex Crimes Surge: Could AI Create a New Generation of Abusers?
